name: Hotel Fairmont Amman
positioning: Fairmont Amman, a city hotel in the Abdoun area with rooms, suites and serviced apartments, plus a Gold lounge level
best_for: Travelers planning longer stays in a serviced apartment

facts.text: The hotel is at 6 Beirut Street, 5th Circle, in the Abdoun area of Amman.
The hotel offers serviced apartments with a lounge, a fully equipped kitchen and a dining area.
Deluxe rooms include complimentary access to spa facilities and pressing of two garments per stay.
Caprice has a lounge called the Caprice Groovy Room that serves signature cocktails.
Nur is a Lebanese restaurant serving Levantine flavors.
Afternoon tea is served at the Crystal Lounge on a themed stand.
The hotel has an outdoor pool, a spa and a gym.
The concierge team can help plan excursions around Jordan.

highlights.text: The Penthouse Suite has a private balcony, an in-suite cinema and a dedicated wellness area.
Gold rooms are on the highest floors and include access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge, with daily breakfast, afternoon tea and evening canapes.
Nasim is a rooftop lounge with a weekend DJ lineup and seasonal events.
The Family Suite is a two-bedroom configuration that combines a One Bedroom Suite with a connecting guest room, with a living area with fireplace and dining space.
Fairmont guest rooms have a spa-inspired bathroom with a rain shower and Le Labo amenities.

considerations.text: The hotel has both smoking and non-smoking room types.
The outdoor pool offers day access to non-resident guests from Sunday to Wednesday.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
